paper: AlphaMemo: Structured Search-Process Memory for Self-Evolving Alpha Mining Agents
headline_agent: structured-search-memory alpha miner, admitted factor pool, LightGBM fusion, and Top-k/drop portfolio
headline_component: first paper-listed representative evolved AlphaMemo factor
component_selection_reason: The paper-specific trajectory, admitted pool, and final fusion are withheld, but Appendix Table 9 prints five representative selected AlphaMemo factors. SSPM_000 is the first listed factor and executes in the released parser, fixing one attributable evolved output without choosing on JKP performance.
source_interpretation: Temporal positive-price gating of log-volume changes followed by 10-bar accumulation, 60-bar normalization, 20-bar minimum, and cross-sectional ranking.
source_metric_context: Table 9 reports absolute selection-split IC metrics and says negative-IC factors can be sign-flipped; it does not disclose whether SSPM_000 was flipped. The common run therefore preserves the literal printed orientation and claims no recovered pool sign.

monthly_adapter.bar_mapping: One source day becomes one JKP month; all 5/10/20/60-bar operators retain their integer windows as months.
monthly_adapter.inputs: Absolute JKP formation-month prc as close and JKP tvol as volume, with released EPS=1e-6 and row-wise NaN-tolerant operator semantics.
monthly_adapter.universe: Fixed formation-date largest 1,000 U.S. equities from the common JKP contract.
monthly_adapter.portfolio: Researcher-supplied common value-weighted long/short deciles from the literal formula score.
monthly_adapter.costs: Common 0/5/10/25/50 bp one-way cases with 10 bp primary.
monthly_adapter.missing_returns: Fixed holdings re-accounted under zero and adverse-100 policies without reranking or reweighting.
monthly_adapter.history: A 100-month pre-formation buffer supports the nested source windows; no future price, volume, or return enters a score.

adapted: daily CSI500 bars to monthly U.S. JKP bars
source selection universe to common top-1,000 U.S. universe
common costs, missing-return policies, and rolling JKP133 attribution
not_claimed: paper search trajectory or admitted pool
